podcast.body: This album features 298 songs, none of which are longer than 40 seconds. It was created in 2020, demonstrating an extreme adaptation to the streaming payment model where only the first 30 seconds of a song are compensated.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album, released in 2020 by the British band The Pocket Gods, featured 298 songs, none of which exceeded 40 seconds in length, representing an extreme adaptation to streaming payment models where payment only occurs after 30 seconds of playback. "a British band called The Pocket Gods released an album in 2020 called 300 by 30. It featured 298 songs, none of which were longer than 40 seconds."
